text: Level two, question three: find the amount on ten thousand rupees at twenty percent per year, compounded half-yearly, for one and a half years. Question four: one thousand rupees is invested at ten percent for the first year and twenty percent for the second, compounded yearly; find the amount. Question five: find the amount on eight thousand rupees at ten percent per year for two and a half years, using compound interest for whole years and simple interest for the half year.
